def bed(args):
    """
    %prog bed maffiles > out.bed

    Convert a folder of maf alignments to the bed features
    then useful to check coverage, etc.
    """
    p = OptionParser(bed.__doc__)
    p.set_alignment_options(priority=50)
    p.add_option("--min-coverage", default=10, type="int",
                 help="Minimum coverage to report [default: %default]")
    p.add_option("--min-score", default=0, type="int",
                 help="Minimum score to report [default: %default]")
    p.add_option("--min-size", default=0, type="int",
                 help="Minimum size to report [default: %default]")
    p.add_option("--min-overlap", default=0, type="int",
                 help="Minimum overlap to report [default: %default]")
    p.add_option("--max-overlap", default=100, type="int",
                 help="Maximum overlap to report [default: %default]")
    p.add_option("--max-size", default=10000, type="int",
                 help="Maximum size to report [default: %default]")
    p.add_option("--min-identity", default=0, type="float",
                 help="Minimum identity to report [default: %default]")
    p.add_option("--min-coverage", default=10, type="int",
                 help="Minimum coverage to report [default: %default]")
    p.add_option("--max-coverage", default=100, type="int",
                 help="Maximum coverage to report [default: %default]")
    p.add_option("--max-indel", default=10000, type="int",
                 help="Maximum indel to report [default: %default]")
    p.add_option("--max-gap", default=10000, type="int",
                 help="Maximum gap to report [default: %default]")
    p.add_option("--max-insertion", default=10000, type="int",
                 help="Maximum insertion to report [default: %default]")
    p.add_option
